# Catalog API

> Browse items.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Crucible-Version: 2026-10` on every request. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource

## Operations

- [ListItems](src/operations/API_ListItems.md): POST /ListItems. Read a page of items. Deprecated.
- [WriteItem](src/operations/API_WriteItem.md): POST /WriteItem.

## Data types

- [Content](src/shapes/Content.md): union. Deprecated.
- [Items](src/shapes/Items.md): list.
- [ListItemsInput](src/shapes/ListItemsInput.md): structure.
- [ListItemsOutput](src/shapes/ListItemsOutput.md): structure.
- [State](src/shapes/State.md): enum.
- [Unavailable](src/shapes/Unavailable.md): error, HTTP 503. Temporarily unavailable.
- [WriteItemInput](src/shapes/WriteItemInput.md): structure.
- [WriteItemOutput](src/shapes/WriteItemOutput.md): structure.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every page above in one file
- [describe.json](describe.json): the whole reference as JSON (`crucible.describe/1`)
- [changes.json](changes.json): the release chain alone (`crucible.changes/1`)
